title: 2 Kings Bible Quiz - Chapter 23
description: Ten questions on 2 Kings 23: Josiah's covenant and reforms, the great Passover, his death at Megiddo and the kings who followed.

questions.text: Where did the king stand when he made a covenant before Yahweh?
questions.explanation: The king stood by the pillar and made a covenant before Yahweh, and all the people agreed to the covenant.

answers.text: On the steps of the altar
At the gate of the city
On the roof of the upper room

questions.text: Where did Josiah carry the ashes of the vessels made for Baal and the Asherah?
questions.explanation: He burned them outside of Jerusalem in the fields of the Kidron and carried their ashes to Bethel.

questions.text: On what did Josiah cast the dust of the burned Asherah?
questions.explanation: He burned the Asherah at the brook Kidron, beat it to dust, and cast its dust on the graves of the common people.

answers.text: On the graves of the common people

questions.text: Which place in the valley of the children of Hinnom did Josiah defile?
questions.explanation: He defiled Topheth, which is in the valley of the children of Hinnom, so that no one might make a son or daughter pass through the fire to Molech.

questions.text: What did Josiah burn with fire after taking away the horses the kings of Judah had given to the sun?
questions.explanation: He took away the horses given to the sun and burned the chariots of the sun with fire.

questions.text: For which gods had Solomon built the high places that Josiah defiled before Jerusalem?
questions.explanation: Solomon had built them for Ashtoreth of the Sidonians, Chemosh of Moab, and Milcom of the children of Ammon.

questions.text: What did Josiah command about the tomb of the man of God who came from Judah?
questions.explanation: He said, "Let him be! Let no one move his bones." So they let his bones alone.

questions.text: Since when had such a Passover not been kept as the one in Josiah's eighteenth year?
questions.explanation: Such a Passover had not been kept from the days of the judges who judged Israel, nor in all the days of the kings of Israel or Judah.

answers.text: Since the days of the judges

questions.text: Where did Pharaoh Necoh kill King Josiah?
questions.explanation: Pharaoh Necoh killed him at Megiddo, when he had seen him.

questions.text: What new name did Pharaoh Necoh give to Eliakim the son of Josiah?
questions.explanation: Pharaoh Necoh made Eliakim the son of Josiah king and changed his name to Jehoiakim.
